what: 749 questions a second independent reviewer wrote (2026-11-06) to try the filled recipes on, after the first review's findings were mended with a rule for each card and a list of words that mean a step more. truth is the reviewer's answer in the unit asked (null: one number cannot answer it, or nothing should be filled; a string such as '40,' means either is acceptable). now is what that build did. Of 399 questions with one recipe that were filled, the reviewer counted 222 lines that were not the sum for the question (this file counts 248, taking 'either' as wrong). A list of words to refuse cannot be finished: each new word (dam, creek, milky, icy, handwashing, aquarium) got the recipe. Not in any test yet: it is the material for the next attempt, which has to fill only a question whose every word it knows.
